optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Plant Procurement Manager, Industrial Gas Supply Network
professionalSummary: Eight years of procurement experience in heavy industry, with five years in plant procurement at a regional cement producer and two years as a purchasing assistant at an engineering distributor. Led the procurement team for three plants, managing maintenance parts, contracted services, and capital equipment tenders under the group procurement policy. Established and maintained a documented supplier risk process, and successfully closed internal audit findings related to purchase order controls.
experienceHighlights:
• Five years in plant procurement, last two as buyer for three plants’ maintenance parts and contracted services under group policy, reporting to plant procurement team leader.
• Operated supplier risk process for three plants’ critical parts, maintaining critical supplier register and quarterly risk reviews with plant maintenance managers.
• Supported capital equipment tenders for kiln refurbishment, preparing tender documents and bid comparison; tender board submissions led by team leader.
• Authored annual procurement boundary notes for each plant and closed two internal audit findings on purchase order controls in 2024.
• Two years as purchasing assistant at an engineering distributor, processing purchase orders and supplier onboarding.
projectsAndWorkSamples:
• Critical supplier register and quarterly risk review pack for one plant.
• Bid comparison for kiln refurbishment tender.
• Audit closure memo for two 2024 findings, with purchase order system references as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience, roles, and specific achievements relevant to the Plant Procurement Manager role, but do not independently confirm the duration of team leadership or the extent of capital equipment tender authority beyond support roles.
